title: Enphase Energy, Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-06
summary: Enphase Energy sold $235 million in Section 45X advanced manufacturing production tax credits to a financial institution for $218.55 million (93% of face value), with the transaction reducing Q1 2026 GAAP gross margin by approximately 6.7 percentage points.
key_points: Enphase Energy entered a Tax Credit Transfer Agreement on March 31, 2026 selling $235 million in Section 45X production tax credits
Purchase price was $218.55 million, representing 93% of face value
The discount from face value was approximately $16.5 million; transaction fees added approximately $2.5 million
Credits relate to 2025 production of eligible components in the United States
Q1 2026 GAAP gross margin expected to be reduced by ~6.7 percentage points vs. prior guidance due to this transaction
Company will exclude these items from non-GAAP financial measures
